title: Study on Veterinary Price Transparency and Workforce Trends
what_it_is: Study on Veterinary Price Transparency and Workforce Trends

sections.label: Veterinary Practice Act implementation
sections.summary: The Veterinary Practice Act was passed in April, and AVS is establishing the Veterinary Council and registration frameworks, reviewing price transparency and veterinary manpower needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The Veterinary Practice Act was passed by Parliament in April this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Since then, the Animal and Veterinary Service (AVS) has been working to establish the Veterinary Council and operationalise the registration and accreditation frameworks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: AVS will partner the Veterinary Council, as part of the review of the Code of Ethics for Veterinarians, to consider how price transparency can be further enhanced.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In addition, AVS is working with the Ministry of Education and the institutes of higher learning to study strategies to meet Singapore's long-term veterinary manpower needs, including the feasibility of establishing additional local training pathways.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Ultrasound can cost $300 to $500, a hospital stay can cost about $200 to $500 a night.

sections.label: Veterinary Act regulation and price transparency
sections.summary: The Act aims to strengthen regulation of veterinary professionals, and the ongoing review with the Veterinary Council covers price transparency measures such as itemisation and fee disclosures.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: The intent of the Act is really to strengthen regulation of veterinary professionals, including upholding standards of professional competence, conduct and ethics, and certainly, with a view to protect public interests and maintain confidence in the profession.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: I just wish to reassure Mr Yip that the review is ongoing and AVS is working with the Veterinary Council.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: And at the same time, it is taking a view towards ensuring that moving forward, the standards continue to be increased to ensure price transparency, including some of the things that Mr Yip has mentioned, potentially studying the prospect of itemisation, fee disclosures, as well as cost communication to the pet owners, so that they can make informed decisions, build trust trust between pet owners and vets, and promote professionalism and fairness across the board.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: So, in relation to price transparency, as well as watching over the cost, it is something that is in the review that is ongoing and we will share more information when ready.
